workProcess.title: How we work
workProcess.subtitle: Designing your dream interior is straightforward, practical, and conducted entirely online.

step1.title: Book your appointment
step1.description: Pick the date and time slot that fits your schedule. We guide you from initial consultation right through to project sign-off.

step2.title: Share your vision
step2.description: During our chat, we review your preferences, functional goals, and budget considerations to build a concept centered around you.

step3.title: Receive your design deck
step3.description: Obtain a visual package complete with layout plans, color palettes, and furniture recommendations, refined until every detail matches your taste.

faq.title: Start transforming with our transparent pricing
faq.subtitle: Select the plan suited to your goals and refresh your rooms with professional online interior advice.

q1.question: Can I book multiple design sessions?
q1.answer: Absolutely. Extra consultations can be booked as your project progresses or whenever further refinements are needed.

q2.question: Do rates vary based on the day or time booked?
q2.answer: No. Our packages carry transparent fixed pricing with no hidden surcharges for weekends or specific times.

q3.question: Are weekend appointments available?
q3.answer: Yes. We offer select weekend slots for clients who prefer coordinating their design plans outside regular work hours.

q4.question: Which payment options do you support?
q4.answer: We welcome credit and debit card payments from Visa and Mastercard.
